pageDescription: Free cURL to C# converter transforms cURL commands into production-ready C# using System.Net.Http.HttpClient with async/await or the RestSharp fluent client. Emits HttpRequestMessage with StringContent, EnsureSuccessStatusCode, and AuthenticationHeaderValue for Basic auth. Ready for .NET 6+, ASP.NET Core controllers, Blazor components, or console apps. Browser-based conversion — your cURL stays on your device.
